'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Josh Gulli DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Josh Gulli]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: The Galen (singular) Deck. Transcription note: sheet Name reads "Josh Galli"; #1 is Knowledge And Defense (V), the objective is on #2 — order kept as sourced

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
